data.title: Delivan targets over 100 UK dealers in electric van push
data.description: Chinese commercial vehicle brand Delivan is targeting a network of more than 100 UK dealerships as it looks to establish itself in the European electric light commercial vehicle market. The Chery-owned brand is currently exhibiting its first production models at IAA Transportation in Hanover.

data.title: Volvo unveils new plug-in hybrid with 200 km electric range
data.description: The new Volvo XC60 Plug-in Hybrid will in the future offer a purely electric range of up to 200 km. Meanwhile, the larger and heavier Volvo XC90 Plug-in Hybrid can travel up to 163 km purely electrically per battery charge.

data.title: Onsemi aims to quadruple power density of EV inverters
data.description: Onsemi has introduced the Embedded Power Platform (EPP), a new architecture for power electronics. According to the semiconductor manufacturer, it enables up to four times higher power density and 15 per cent lower power losses in traction inverters for electric vehicles.

data.title: Thailand: Isuzu begins new battery-swapping trial for electric trucks
data.description: Isuzu has launched a new battery-swapping trial for electric trucks in Thailand's logistics sector. It has partnered with two local companies for this initiative: V. Cargo, a comprehensive logistics service provider, and Home Product Center (HomePro), a major retailer of home improvement products and services.

data.title: Helsinki expands EV mandate to vans and minibuses
data.description: Helsinki is gradually phasing out combustion engines in its municipal fleet - and, following passenger cars, the Finnish capital will now focus on pure EVs where procurement of its transporters and minibuses are concerned. Stricter requirements will also apply to companies that transport people or goods on behalf of the city.

data.title: Grab to expand its autonomous vehicle fleet in Singapore to 50 units
data.description: Singapore-based Grab, best known for its ride-hailing and food-delivery 'super app' in Southeast Asia, has announced plans to expand its autonomous vehicle fleet in its home market to 50 units. By 2030, the company aims to deploy thousands of AVs across Southeast Asia.

data.title: Solid-state batteries: Factorial leverages Japanese electrolyte expertise
data.description: Battery developer Factorial Energy has formed a strategic partnership with Japanese company Mitsui Kinzoku to accelerate the industrialization of one of its solid-state battery platforms. Mitsui Kinzoku is a manufacturer of solid sulfphide-based electrolytes.

data.title: Quantron and HyperView establish joint venture in China
data.description: Quantron and Chinese technology company HyperView have agreed to establish a new joint venture. Quantron China will develop a platform for battery-electric and hydrogen-powered commercial vehicles, with Foxconn joining as an industrial manufacturing partner.

data.title: Xpeng to offer its technology to additional manufacturers beyond Volkswagen
data.description: Chinese electric car manufacturer Xpeng reportedly plans to offer its platforms and software solutions to other foreign automotive groups in the future. In addition to its existing cooperation with Volkswagen, the company aims to tap into new revenue streams.

data.title: BMW intensifies production in Hungary amid high iX3 demand
data.description: BMW has increased production of the iX3 at its Debrecen plant from two to three shifts this month -effectively moving to round-the-clock manufacturing. The reason is high demand: BMW has stated that 100,000 orders for the iX3 have already been placed in Europe alone.

data.title: DCS expands preferred partner network across 17 European markets
data.description: Digital Charging Solutions (DCS) significantly expanded its Preferred Partner Network over the summer. A total of 28 new CPO partnerships were added across 17 European markets - including in Germany, where Fastned has recently joined the network.

data.title: Panasonic Energy opens battery development centre in Osaka
data.description: Panasonic Energy has opened a new research and development center for lithium-ion batteries in Kadoma, near Osaka. The so-called Energy Innovation Square consolidates the development of materials and battery cells through to prototype construction. By 2031, Panasonic aims to double its development efficiency through this initiative.

data.title: It doesn’t always have to be Tesla: The Rivian R2 emerges as a Model Y alternative
data.description: The Rivian R2 brings fresh air to the uniform mid-size electric SUV segment. The model competes against the Tesla Model Y, BMW iX3, and others, while also serving as an electronics donor for future VW models. On the first test drive, it impresses with comfort and off-road capability, but it won’t arrive in Europe until at least 2028.

data.title: Porsche produces cathode active materials from recycled raw materials
data.description: For the first time, Porsche has succeeded in producing battery cells whose cathode active materials are made from 100 per cent recycled raw materials such as lithium, nickel, cobalt, and manganese, sourced from its own high-voltage batteries. The battery recycling startup Cylib was also involved in the project.

data.title: Ford Pro unveils additional Transit City body variants
data.description: At the IAA Transportation in Hanover, Ford Pro is showcasing the full range of body styles for the new Transit City, the latest and fully electric member of the Transit family. Additionally, Ford Pro is presenting the large E-Transit with a larger battery and increased range.

data.title: Mercedes-Benz GLA: series production of all-electric model begins
data.description: The new Mercedes-Benz GLA is now entering series production, with the dealer premiere scheduled for November. Initially, only all-electric variants will be built at the Rastatt plant, with hybrids and internal combustion models set to follow later in the year.

data.title: CATL unveils truck battery with up to 1,000 km range
data.description: CATL has unveiled its Tectrans II battery solution for heavy-duty electric commercial vehicles at IAA Transportation. At its maximum capacity, it's said to offer a range of up to 1,000 km and, according to CATL, can be charged to 80 per cent in 25 minutes using megawatt-level fast charging.

data.title: VinFast revises product strategy in India over cost concerns
data.description: A year after entering the Indian car market, VinFast is taking a step back from its original product strategy and exploring a new approach. Unable to meet local manufacturing cost targets for its global models, the company is now shifting to market-specific products.

data.title: EZO secures €150 million to expand UK and Ireland charging networks
data.description: Irish charging provider EZO has secured €150 million in senior debt financing to expand its EV charging network across the UK and Ireland. This will fund the design, installation, operation and maintenance of more than 3000 charge points - with a combined capacity of over 100 MW.

data.title: Kinetic prepares Melbourne depot for 60 ‘zero-emission’ buses
data.description: Kinetic, Australasia's largest bus operator, has completed electrification upgrades at its Sunshine West depot in Melbourne. This will enable 66 buses to be charged at the site - up from 24 previously.
